note: Public maintainer toolkit: registry, template, scaffolder, and public-project report. Public Devin tools are listed below; the maintainer's private runtime remains kind=system and is excluded from public-project reports. Unrelated personal repositories are not part of this catalog. CI is inline per public project; see README.md.

ci.previous_architecture: reusable workflows in the private devin-ci/devin-powerups hub
ci.reason: Reusable workflows living in a private repo are not reliably accessible from public repos, so each project ships a self-contained ci.yml.
ci.shape: test job (pytest for Python repos, node --test for devin-bridge) on windows-latest + ubuntu-latest, plus a secrets-scan job over the repository tree excluding .git, fixtures/ and node_modules/; test source is scanned.

known_issues: PyPI publishing is partial; unlisted packages install from pinned GitHub sources until released.
devin-office is a source-only service, not yet a distributable CLI; macOS support is planned, not claimed.

linux.label: Linux
linux.description: Native Linux execution plus optional Devin VM/QwenPaw workload delegation.

personal_windows.label: Personal Windows
personal_windows.description: Windows host execution plus optional Devin VM/QwenPaw workload delegation.

corporate_windows.label: Corporate Windows
corporate_windows.description: Restricted Windows execution that is intentionally self-contained: no VM, QwenPaw, Slack requirement, external delegation, or external compute.

devin-office.manual_note: Source-only dashboard service; no distributable package metadata yet.

qa.label: QA
qa.description: Verify session claims and local Devin state with deterministic evidence.

evaluation.label: Evaluation
evaluation.description: Measure changes with synthetic fixtures, rubrics, and local metrics.

security.label: Security
security.description: Reduce risk around secrets, policy-gated actions, and noisy sessions.

memory.label: Memory
memory.description: Search, connect, and preserve agent knowledge with optional ACP integrations.

operations.label: Operations
operations.description: Inspect, back up, export, and maintain Devin data and projects.

agent.label: Agent
agent.description: Convenience alias for the memory and decision tools.

full.label: Full
full.description: All installable public tools; source-only services are listed separately.

all.label: All
all.description: Alias for the full installable profile.

repositories.name: devin-powerups

corporate_windows.reason: local generators work offline; GitHub-backed maintainer reports require explicit credentials

repositories.description: Public maintainer hub: registry, roadmap, project template, scaffolder, release checks, and community catalog generators.

repositories.name: devin-devkit
repositories.description: Profile-based installer for the public Devin tools across Linux, Personal Windows and Corporate Windows; reads the registry manifest and installs isolated CLIs with uv, plus the Node bridge with npm.

repositories.name: homebrew-tap

personal_windows.reason: Homebrew targets Linux and macOS; Windows installs use the Scoop bucket

corporate_windows.reason: Homebrew targets Linux and macOS; Windows installs use the Scoop bucket

repositories.description: Homebrew tap with formulas for the public devin-* CLIs; install on Linux or macOS via `brew install Icaro0310/tap/<tool>`. Content is written by release automation, consumed read-only.

repositories.name: scoop-bucket

linux.reason: Scoop is Windows-only; Linux and macOS installs use the Homebrew tap

repositories.description: Scoop bucket with manifests for the public devin-* CLIs on Windows; install via `scoop install Icaro0310/<tool>`. Content is written by release automation, consumed read-only.

repositories.name: devin-internals-spec
repositories.description: Documented internals of Devin Desktop/CLI stores + schema-version detection + fixtures + devin-inspect CLI.

repositories.name: devin-redact
repositories.description: Secret/PII redaction that understands Devin tool-call semantics, in-place in SQLite, with a verification gate.

repositories.name: devin-history
repositories.description: Export and audit Devin session history — markdown notes, JSON, CSV, Obsidian-ready.

repositories.name: devin-doctor
repositories.description: Diagnose a Devin Desktop installation: stores, schema, locks, config, disk — with fix suggestions.

repositories.name: devin-pm
repositories.description: Project manager over sessions: per-repo rollups, milestones, status reports, registry.json.

repositories.name: devin-qa-pack
repositories.description: Flagship QA audit: verifies session deliverable claims against tool-call ground truth and reports PASS/PARTIAL/UNVERIFIED.

repositories.name: devin-metrics
repositories.description: Local-only session observability: activity, context size, and token peaks per project/model/day; zero telemetry. Devin does not persist cost fields, so cost is not claimed. Includes an optional dashboard subpackage and command.

repositories.name: devin-backup
repositories.description: Safe snapshot/verify/restore/rotate of Devin stores with schema-version manifests.

repositories.name: devin-search
repositories.description: FTS5 full-text search across all Devin sessions, role-tagged and project-filtered.

repositories.name: devin-graph
repositories.description: Knowledge graph: sessions, projects, files touched, tools used — queryable edges.

repositories.name: devin-evals
repositories.overlap_note: Complements official Devin Dreaming with deterministic, seed-controlled synthetic sessions carrying known defects (D01-D09) for reproducibility and agent assurance evaluation.
repositories.description: Deterministic eval harness: replay recorded sessions against rubric graders; the `dream` subgroup generates synthetic sessions with known verdicts (D01-D09, absorbs devin-dream).

repositories.name: devin-memory
repositories.overlap_note: Complements official Devin Memory with local evidence provenance and quarantine.
repositories.description: Anti-poisoning memory store: provenance, versioning, quarantine gate, and session-learning utilities.

repositories.name: devin-janitor
repositories.description: Session lifecycle janitor: export-then-delete pipeline, tiered classification, pluggable judge, pending-retry for locked stores.

repositories.name: devin-bridge
repositories.description: Policy-gated ACP client (Node.js, CI matrix Node 22 + 24): isolated sessions per repo with allow/deny/ask permission policy.

repositories.name: devin-orchestrator
repositories.description: Background-worker fan-out policy: deterministic planner enforcing worker caps (max 3), no nesting, read-only profiles for review, collect-before-report. Skill + always-on rule.
repositories.note: PyPI distribution is devin-fanout because devin-orchestrator is occupied; console command remains devin-orchestrator. Absorbed devin-subagent-orchestrator draft (never published).

repositories.name: personal-agent-system
repositories.description: Private maintainer runtime for personal workflows; excluded from public project reports (kind=system).

repositories.name: devin-dashboard
repositories.description: Private environment-monitoring deployment for the maintainer; not a public user tool.

repositories.name: devin-office
repositories.description: Local-first Devin session and subagent dashboard with standalone and optional split modes.

repositories.name: qwenpaw-suite

corporate_windows.reason: requires an optional self-hosted model runtime outside the corporate local-only guarantee

repositories.description: Optional QwenPaw add-on for self-hosted model operators. Includes the local-model bridge, health checks, and GitHub/local documentation sync.

repositories.name: poordjaevin
repositories.description: Djævin: fork of poordjaevin adding a Devin ACP backend (uses the model Devin already runs, no extra download); local NLI backend stays as fully-offline fallback.

repositories.name: awesome-devin
repositories.description: Curated awesome-list of Devin tooling and resources (CC0).

repositories.name: devin-switch
repositories.description: Switch between Devin configuration profiles (hooks, MCP, models) with snapshot, sha256 verify, atomic write, journal and rollback. Dry-run by default; secrets never printed.

repositories.name: devin-skill-catalog
repositories.overlap_note: Complements official Devin Skills with local inventory, lint, quarantine and promotion gates for skills and rules. It does not define or run skills.
repositories.description: Lifecycle + quality gates for .devin skills/rules: scan, lint, diff, G1/G2 gates, quarantined→approved→active lifecycle, sha256-verified export/import bundles (imports land quarantined).

repositories.name: devin-learning
repositories.description: Learning-loop runtime (SessionEnd hooks → .devin/skills/learned-*, hook-fires.jsonl). Absorbed into devin-powerups — never had its own repo; entry exists so devin-pm verify reconciles session history.
